title: Pin raw_sample_diagnostic read-only contract (eager-invalidation pin depends on it)
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:958 + python/src/lichen/timing/stratum.py:422-424: the zzw5 eager-invalidation pin rests entirely on raw_sample_diagnostic()'s read-only contract, and that test is its ONLY consumer in the suite. A future regression that makes the diagnostic revalidate (lazy clear) would pass line 958 while eager invalidation is silently lost. Fix: add one assert that a raw read on a live tracker does not change last_rejection_reason or state (pins the contract directly).
